fields.description: Role notified when a Wheel Type's in-stock count drops below its reorder point.
fields.label: Reorder Notify Role

fields.description: Percentage of a wheel's diamond-layer volume that's never counted as usable.
fields.label: Usable Volume Floor %

fields.description: Every Wheel this module creates or auto-detects from stock lives in this Warehouse. A Stock Entry bringing a Wheel Type's Item into this Warehouse is blocked unless that Item already has a Wheel Type — nothing enters this Warehouse without a real spec behind it.
fields.label: Default Warehouse

fields.description: Income account credited when a Wheel Scrap Sale is submitted — e.g. recovered aluminum sold off a retired Wheel. Left blank, creating a Wheel Scrap Sale is blocked with a clear error rather than posting to the wrong account by default.
fields.label: Scrap Sales Account

fields.description: Asset/inventory account credited for the wear-cost value leaving a Wheel as it's used — the other side of the Wear Cost Account below. Left blank, Measurement Event's wear-cost Journal Entry is skipped (not blocked) rather than posted to the wrong account.
fields.label: Wheel Asset Account

fields.description: Expense account debited for a Wheel's wear cost on every submitted Measurement Event (the EGP value of material worn away since the last reading). Left blank, the wear-cost Journal Entry is skipped (not blocked) rather than posted to the wrong account.
fields.label: Wheel Wear Cost Account

fields.description: Switches Wheel Tracker's own field names, doctype names, and messages to Arabic for everyone — without changing System Settings, any User's own language, or anything outside this module.
fields.label: Language
